Compute mean, sd, and CV for all Peptides, or proteins, for all interactions and all samples.

Source: R/prolfqua-deprecated.R
summarize_stats.Rd

Compute mean, sd, and CV for all Peptides, or proteins, for all interactions and all samples.

summarize stats output (compute quantiles)

Usage

summarize_stats(lfqdata, factor_key = lfqdata$relevant_factor_keys())

summarize_stats_quantiles(
  stats_res,
  factor_keys_depth,
  stats = c("sd", "CV"),
  probs = c(0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.9)
)

Arguments

lfqdata

LFQData object with the data and its configuration

factor_key

character vector - factor columns to group by (default: relevant_factor_keys)

stats_res

result of running summarize_stats

factor_keys_depth

character vector - factor columns at current depth

stats

summarize either sd or CV

probs

for which quantiles 10, 20 etc.

Value

summarize_stats(): a tibble with one row per hierarchy element and level of factor_key, with the columns nrReplicates, nrMeasured, nrNAs, sd, var, meanAbundance, medianAbundance, CV (untransformed data only) and interaction.

summarize_stats_quantiles(): a list with long, a tibble with one row per factor level and quantile (columns probs and quantiles), and wide, the same quantiles with one column per factor level.

Note

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use LFQData$get_Stats()$stats(). See prolfqua-deprecated.

Deprecated in prolfqua 1.9.5; use LFQData$get_Stats()$stats_quantiles(). See prolfqua-deprecated.
